title: Pure Horus
summary: The 2023-24 Horus cards built around King's Sarcophagus, with generic Rank 8s, Links and staples; the old Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV cards don't use the Sarcophagus and stay out. King's Sarcophagus sends a card from your hand to the GY to send a Horus monster from the Deck, up to four times a turn. Each Son of Horus then summons itself from the GY while you control the Sarcophagus. Imsety discards itself to search the Sarcophagus and draw. Duamutef, Hapi and Qebehsenuef react whenever the opponent removes one of your cards: they draw, recycle cards, or stop attacks and targeting. Walls of the Imperial Tomb, the newest card, counts as King's Sarcophagus in the Field Zone and searches a Horus. Horus the Black Flame Deity sends a card on the field to the GY and wipes the monsters when they remove your Horus.
